sonnet.problem: Card 1 tells the baker the gospel 'wasn't devised by man' and then asks where it came from. The two wrong answers on card 2, 'the teachers of the Law' and 'the elders of the churches', are both human sources, so the setup line rules them out and points to the one non-human answer.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
